Large-scale data breaches on the rise, latest OAIC statistics reveal

Published:   26 October 2026

New statistics from the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (OAIC) reveal that incidents reported under the Notifiable Data Breach (NDB) scheme continue to rise, with a significant increase in the number of large-scale breaches affecting Australians in the first half of 2026. The latest NDB statistics, covering January through June 2026, showed that the OAIC received 667 notifications, a minor increase over the 662 notifications received in the previous reporting period.
